description: This file is a PHP class that implements a coupon total extension controller for the OpenCart platform. It manages rendering the coupon management page and handling coupon save operations within the admin interface.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing coupons in the total extension module of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the coupon management page, initializing necessary data and checking coupon status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for saving coupon data, validating input, and providing JSON responses.
